About / The engineer behind the work

Broad by curiosity.
Grounded by ownership.

I’m a fifth-year software engineering student in Edmonton with 16 months of industry experience in Alberta’s energy sector. I like software with a visible reason to exist: a store that needs a better workflow, a mobile interaction that must feel natural, or a sports decision that should be explainable.

Agentic tools help me move quickly, but the engineering standard stays the same: understand the architecture, make tradeoffs explicit, test the important boundaries, and be able to explain why the system behaves the way it does.

01

Start with the real constraint

People, privacy, devices, data quality, and operating habits shape the system.

02

Make failure visible

Recovery paths, validation, tests, and honest product boundaries are part of the build.

03

Own the explanation

A project is not finished until I can trace it, defend it, debug it, and improve it.
